children: NOBA Bank Group AB (publ) issued SEK 350M and NOK 350M 3-year Senior Preferred bonds at 3m STIBOR/NIBOR +102bps, to be listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. Settlement is 1 Oct 2026 under its SEK 10B MTN programme.
Adds SEK funding, bolstering liquidity and terming out liabilities.
Diversifies currency mix; taps Norwegian investor base.
Print level signals current credit spread for NOBA risk.
Improves secondary liquidity and pricing transparency.
Indicates remaining headroom for future issuance.

This is a routine funding action consistent with banks’ ongoing liability management. A larger catalyst would be scale-up issuance, tighter spreads, or use-of-proceeds tied to growth, buybacks, or regulatory capital changes.
